purpose: Executable transformed-GLaS mask contract with explicit two-level gland authority and hybrid nucleus authority boundaries.

constraints.mask_statement: Require preprocessing revision, transformed label-map digest, patch grade, and explicit gland_instance_authority_kind. Keep nucleus-instance original_instance_mask_digest independent from the dedicated original_gland_instance_mask_digest; a semantic gland proxy binds only derived_gland_component_map_sha256.
required_inputs: separately digested nucleus-instance authority when supplied
known_limitations: A semantic connected-component map is an exterior-topology proxy, not the original GLaS instance annotation.

constraints.mask_statement: Preserve every zero pixel exactly; use only explicit nonzero transformed Stroma as the non-gland semantic source and never use zero as lumen or stroma.
generation_handoff: Do not inpaint protected zero pixels.
known_limitations: Exact zero semantics depend on the frozen preprocessing revision.

constraints.mask_statement: A dataset-native gland raster binds original_gland_instance_mask_digest and may preserve original gland IDs. A semantic connected-component proxy binds derived_gland_component_map_sha256 and certifies exterior topology only. Neither field may overwrite the nucleus-instance original_instance_mask_digest.
required_inputs: dataset-native GLaS instance mask for original instance guarantees, or
digest-bound semantic gland-component proxy for exterior-only guarantees
generation_handoff: Render continuous gland epithelium and lumina; instance-safe mask geometry does not guarantee microscopic gland quality.
known_limitations: Touching original glands may remain one semantic proxy component.
The proxy cannot certify original gland-instance identity.
Nucleus-instance and gland-instance digests are independent namespaces.

constraints.mask_statement: Use transformed Stroma only through an existing directed gland/non-gland interface, change only declared fine IDs, and preserve all other labels; mask edit must not claim that the source is histologically pure stroma.
generation_handoff: Distinguish true stroma from lumen, mucin, debris, muscle, or inflammation during H&E generation and final audit.
known_limitations: The transformed semantic label cannot recover the non-gland histologic subtype.
